login.title: Sign in
login.sub: Your password, then your passkey. The passkey never leaves your device.
login.passkeyNote: Face ID, Touch ID or your device PIN confirms it's you — there's nothing to type and nothing to leak.
login.totpLabel: Six-digit code from your authenticator app
login.betaBody: Sign-in is wired to the server in the next stage. Meanwhile, the demo runs the full client on a fixture mailbox.

join.step_invite_lead: ohmail is invite-only during the beta. Paste the code from your invite mail — it only works for the address it was sent to.
join.inviteHint: It looks like OHMAIL-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX. Spaces and lower case are fine.
join.inviteMissing: Paste the code from your invite mail to continue.
join.step_account_lead: This is your ohmail sign-in. It is not a new email address — your mail stays where it is.
join.emailHint: Use the address your invite was sent to.
join.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. This is the first of two factors; the next step adds a passkey.
join.step_factor_lead: A passkey is the fastest and the safest. If this device cannot make one, an authenticator app works just as well.
join.passkeyNote: Face ID, Touch ID or your device PIN. The key itself never leaves the device.
join.totpScan: Scan this with your authenticator app, or type the key below into it.
join.step_codes_lead: Each code signs you in once if you ever lose your passkey and your authenticator. We cannot show them again, and we never send them by email.
join.codesConfirm: I have saved these somewhere safe.
join.step_mailbox_lead: ohmail organizes a mailbox you already own, in place — real folders on your real server. Nothing is copied to a new address.
join.mailboxUserPlaceholder: usually the same as the address
join.appPasswordHint: Stored encrypted, used only to reach this mailbox, and revocable at your provider at any time.
join.step_plan_lead: Start with 14 days free. No card, and nothing renews on its own.
join.trialNote: The 14-day trial needs no card and runs the deterministic rules — screening, filing, Reads, Receipts, Resurface. Managed AI actions (drafts and pre-suggestions) start with the subscription, so nothing is spent on your behalf during the trial.
join.footer: Your mail stays in real folders on your own server.
join.expiredTitle: That took a little too long
join.expired: The setup session lasts five minutes and this one has expired. Sign in with the email and password you just chose and we will pick up where you left off — your invite is already used, so you will not need it again.
join.unavailableBody: This build of ohmail is not pointed at a server, so accounts cannot be created here. The demo runs the whole client on a fixture mailbox.

about.title: ohmail — demo
about.p1: This is the real ohmail client running on a fixture mailbox: the same sync engine that will talk to your IMAP servers, bootstrapped from local demo data. Every click lands as an optimistic mutation and is confirmed by the demo adapter — no network, nothing leaves this tab.
about.p2: The Screener holds first-time senders until you decide. One click files a sender to Ohbox, Reads or Receipts — the ✓ half also marks the held mail read — and the decision becomes a rule for future mail. Reads and Receipts share a skim stream where scrolling past an item marks it seen at the waterline. Tags group messages across views without moving them.
about.keys: Keyboard: j/k, ↵, y + o/r/c/n/x in the Screener (⇧ marks read), t, /, c, ⌘K.
